items.description: Replacement of stolen clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery
items.rationale: Sections 2.6.3 and 4.2.6 require movable contents to be co-insured on the schedule, which is not confirmed. If covered, ordinary clothing and modest everyday jewellery qualify for like-for-like replacement under 4.4.5–4.4.6 and 7.1.1(d); EUR 850 is provisional because the summary gives no item counts or values.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of forced back door
items.rationale: If forcible-removal cover is in force, section 2.6.2 covers the forced-door damage and section 5.2.2 covers immediate boarding and like-for-like restoration of the lock and frame, without double recovery under Part 7. An ordinary gross allowance of EUR 480 is below the EUR 1,000 securing cap; no deductible is stated.
